wiki.title: John Jordan (West Virginia politician)
wiki.extract: John K. Jordan is an American politician serving as a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates for the 42nd district. On January 13, 2026, governor Patrick Morrisey appointed Jordan to fill the vacancy left by Brandon Steele. Jordan graduated from the University of the Cumberlands with a bachelor's in business administration. He also earned a Master of Science in Church Leadership from Assemblies of God Theological Seminary. He has been the lead pastor at Calvary Assembly of God in Beckley, West Virginia, since 1998 and has also served as the chaplain at Raleigh General Hospital since 2000.
